mapper.sql: pi.id, pi.instance_code as code, pi.instance_name as name, pi.capability_code, pi.extension_point, pi.stage_code, pi.order_no, pi.version, pi.entrypoint, pi.status, pi.timeout_ms, pi.plugin_type, pi.is_deleted, pi.orphaned
mapper.select:
select
from kb_plugin_instances pi
and pi.is_deleted = 0
and ( pi.instance_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or pi.instance_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or pi.capability_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and pi.status = #{status}
and pi.plugin_type = #{pluginType}
order by pi.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into kb_plugin_instances( instance_code, instance_name, entrypoint, version, capability_code, extension_point, stage_code, order_no, timeout_ms, plugin_type, status, is_deleted, orphaned ) values( #{code}, #{name}, #{entrypoint}, #{version}, #{capabilityCode}, #{extensionPoint}, #{stageCode}, #{orderNo}, #{timeoutMs}, #{pluginType}, 1, 0, 0 ) on duplicate key update instance_code = values(instance_code), instance_name = values(instance_name), version = values(version), capability_code = values(capability_code), extension_point = values(extension_point), stage_code = values(stage_code), order_no = values(order_no), timeout_ms = values(timeout_ms), plugin_type = values(plugin_type), orphaned = 0
mapper.select:
select
from kb_plugin_instances pi where pi.status = 1 and pi.is_deleted = 0 and pi.plugin_type = 'SYNC' and pi.extension_point = #{extensionPoint} and pi.stage_code = #{stageCode} order by pi.order_no asc, pi.id asc
